title: Semantic Chains: From Reachable Facts to Justified Answers
abstract: arXiv:2611.14252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How can the facts that justify an answer be found from a question and presented as a sequence of connected statements? This paper models a context as a graph of logical facts and takes as given which expressions represent each fact. A parent fact can express a relation among its subfacts, and a preserving edge allows the content of a subfact to be recovered within a full representation of its parent. Suppose a root fact justifies the full answer and a path of preserving edges leads from that root to a fact that designates an object shared by the question and the answer. Under the conditions of the model, a search starting from the objects in the question reaches the root and covers every fact in the selected expansion. The root then admits a text that forms a single link connecting the question to the full answer and justifying it. translated_title: 语义链：从可及事实到有据之答案
translated_abstract: 如何从问题出发找到能够证明某个答案的事实，并将其呈现为一系列相互关联的陈述？本文将上下文建模为一个由逻辑事实构成的图，并把“哪些表达式代表哪些事实”作为给定条件。一个父事实可以表达其若干子事实之间的关系，而一条保持边允许在父事实的完整表示中恢复子事实的内容。假设某个根事实能够证明完整答案，且存在一条由保持边构成的路径，从该根事实通往一个指称问题与答案所共享对象的事实。在模型给定的条件下，从问题中的对象出发的搜索能够到达该根事实，并覆盖所选展开中的每一个事实。于是该根事实可以对应一段文本，构成连接问题与完整答案的单一链条环节，并证明该答案。对于包含多个环节的链条，本文在所述范围内给出了候选顺序的完整枚举。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将上下文建模为带保持边的逻辑事实图，证明了从问题中的对象出发的搜索可以到达证明答案的根事实，从而构建出连接问题与有据答案的“语义链”，并对多环节链条给出候选顺序的完整枚举。
en_tdlr: This paper models a context as a graph of logical facts with preserving edges and proves that a search starting from the question's objects reaches a root fact that justifies the answer, enabling the construction of "semantic chains" linking questions to justified answers, with a complete enumeration of candidate orders for multi-link chains.
